title.narrative: Clean technology innovation programme for SMEs and start-ups in the Republic of Moldova

description.narrative: The project will support the transition to a low-carbon economy in Moldova by promoting clean technology innovations and entrepreneurship in SMES and start-ups through the development of a vibrant cleantech ecosystem to create green jobs and industries. The Republic of Moldova, through the Energy Efficiency Agency (EEA), requested UNIDO#s support to increase the competitiveness and productivity of industries in Moldova by promoting the growth of the cleantech sector.
